title: Kestrel Vehicle Program Schedule — Reservation Deposit, Hold and Buyer Age Terms
content:
Every order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements opens as a reservation, and the reservation terms are set by the vehicle program of the listed vehicle. The figures below apply to all orders under each program.

| Vehicle program | Reservation deposit (refundable) | Hold length (calendar days) | One extension adds (calendar days) | Extensions allowed per order | Deposit refunded in full automatically when the hold lapses unsigned | Minimum buyer age on the reservation date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | $250.00 | 3 | 2 | 1 | Yes | 18 |
| Kestrel Inspected | $250.00 | 3 | 2 | 1 | Yes | 18 |
| Kestrel Certified | $500.00 | 5 | 3 | 1 | Yes | 18 |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | $500.00 | 5 | 3 | 1 | Yes | 18 |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | $1000.00 | 7 | 3 | 2 | Yes | 18 |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | $750.00 | 7 | 3 | 2 | Yes | 18 |

**Deposit payment channels.** Under every program the reservation deposit is accepted by debit card, credit card or ACH bank transfer.

**How the figures read.**
- The hold length is counted in calendar days after the reservation date, with the reservation date as day 0.
- One extension adds its days to the hold expiration date current at the time; the extensions-allowed column is the most an order may receive.
- The buyer's age is computed from the date of birth on the customer profile, as of the reservation date.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Kestrel Certified vehicle reserved on day 0 is held through day 5; one extension, the only one that program allows, would carry the hold expiration date to day 8. The same reservation under Kestrel Premium Certified would be held through day 7 and could be extended twice, to day 10 and then to day 13.
